basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old software engineer currently based in Seattle. I have a keen interest in strategy games, particularly those involving castle sieges, which I indulge in during weekends. Originally from a small town in Ohio, I've always been fascinated by music, especially at the intersection of country and rock, which is why I follow artists like Jason Isbell. Despite the busy work life, I enjoy keeping up with investment opportunities, particularly in psychedelics, and dream of traveling more once things settle down. I'm single and often online during the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from a midwestern university. My expertise in software engineering is enhanced through self-teaching and continuous learning via online courses and Reddit discussions. I've also developed a strong interest in financial markets and investment strategies.
